title: Can I SURVIVE Capture Anything?
summary: Capture Anything variant vs higher-rated online humans: any piece may capture any piece including your own (e.g. eat your own pawn to free a bishop or escape back-rank mate). Goal: win three games.
rules: Any piece may capture a piece of either colour, including your own pieces (normal movement patterns apply).
Capturing your own king is presumably illegal (not stated).
win_condition: Checkmate. Video goal: win 3 games vs higher-rated players.

board.theme_notes: chess.com green/cream; orange arrow shows a piece capturing its own piece; 3-min clocks

current_impl_issues: Legacy captureany matches ('not the king'). Bot should be ~1750.
